## The 24 doors

::: {.advent-act-heading}
<span class="advent-act-number">01 — 07</span>
<div><h3>From context to representations</h3><p>How does text become a numerical input the model can process?</p></div>
</div>
:::

::: {.advent-grid}
::: {.advent-card #day-01}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">01</span><span class="advent-time">6 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">THE STARTING POINT</p>
<h4>What does an LLM predict?</h4>
<p>What does a language model actually compute from a context?</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="llm-overview.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="exercises/llm-overview.qmd">Practise</a></div>
:::
::: {.advent-card #day-02}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">02</span><span class="advent-time">5 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">THE CONTEXT</p>
<h4>What information does the model have?</h4>
<p>Distinguish the prefix supplied to the model from the continuation it must predict.</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="llm-overview.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="exercises/llm-overview.qmd">Practise</a></div>
:::
::: {.advent-card #day-03}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">03</span><span class="advent-time">6 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">BREAKING DOWN TEXT</p>
<h4>How does text become tokens?</h4>
<p>Follow a character string as it is segmented into discrete units.</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="text-data.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="exercises/text-data.qmd">Practise</a></div>
:::
::: {.advent-card #day-04}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">04</span><span class="advent-time">5 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">IDENTIFIERS</p>
<h4>From token to token ID</h4>
<p>Distinguish a readable token, its vocabulary entry, and its integer ID.</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="text-data.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="exercises/text-data.qmd">Practise</a></div>
:::
::: {.advent-card #day-05}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">05</span><span class="advent-time">7 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">VECTORS</p>
<h4>An ID becomes a vector</h4>
<p>Understand how the embedding matrix provides a numerical representation.</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="embedding-space.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="exercises/embedding-space.qmd">Practise</a></div>
:::
::: {.advent-card #day-06}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">06</span><span class="advent-time">7 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">ORDER</p>
<h4>Why does position matter?</h4>
<p>Why must representations account for the order of tokens?</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="positional-encoding.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="exercises/positional-encoding.qmd">Practise</a></div>
:::
::: {.advent-card #day-07}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">07</span><span class="advent-time">6 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">CONTEXTUALIZATION</p>
<h4>One token, multiple representations</h4>
<p>Why can two occurrences of the same token have different representations?</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="contextualized-representations.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="exercises/contextualized-representations.qmd">Practise</a></div>
:::
:::

::: {.advent-act-heading}
<span class="advent-act-number">08 — 12</span>
<div><h3>Transformer computation</h3><p>How are hidden states transformed inside the blocks?</p></div>
</div>
:::

::: {.advent-grid}
::: {.advent-card #day-08}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">08</span><span class="advent-time">7 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">ARCHITECTURE</p>
<h4>What does a Transformer block do?</h4>
<p>Locate attention, the MLP, residual connections, and normalization.</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="transformer.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="exercises/transformer.qmd">Practise</a></div>
:::
::: {.advent-card #day-09}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">09</span><span class="advent-time">8 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">THREE PROJECTIONS</p>
<h4>The three roles of Q, K, and V</h4>
<p>Distinguish Query, Key, and Value, then predict the effect of changing V.</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="queries-keys-values.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="exercises/queries-keys-values.qmd">Practise</a></div>
:::
::: {.advent-card #day-10}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">10</span><span class="advent-time">8 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">ATTENTION</p>
<h4>How does attention work?</h4>
<p>Follow scores, scaling, softmax, and value aggregation.</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="scaled-dot-product-attention.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="exercises/scaled-dot-product-attention.qmd">Practise</a></div>
:::
::: {.advent-card #day-11}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">11</span><span class="advent-time">7 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">CAUSALITY</p>
<h4>Preventing access to future tokens</h4>
<p>Understand how causal masking blocks access to future tokens.</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="causal-masking.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="exercises/causal-masking.qmd">Practise</a></div>
:::
::: {.advent-card #day-12}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">12</span><span class="advent-time">8 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">STATE UPDATES</p>
<h4>Beyond attention</h4>
<p>Describe the roles of the MLP, residual connections, and normalization.</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="transformer.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="transformer-block-walkthrough.qmd">See the code</a><a href="exercises/transformer-block-walkthrough.qmd">Practise</a></div>
:::
:::

::: {.advent-act-heading}
<span class="advent-act-number">13 — 18</span>
<div><h3>Prediction and generation</h3><p>How do hidden states become a distribution, then a selected token?</p></div>
</div>
:::

::: {.advent-grid}
::: {.advent-card #day-13}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">13</span><span class="advent-time">6 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">OUTPUT SCORES</p>
<h4>Logits: scores before probabilities</h4>
<p>Interpret logits as unnormalized scores over the vocabulary.</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="logits.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="exercises/logits.qmd">Practise</a></div>
:::
::: {.advent-card #day-14}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">14</span><span class="advent-time">7 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">PROBABILITIES</p>
<h4>From scores to a distribution</h4>
<p>Turn logits into conditional probabilities using softmax.</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="probabilities.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="exercises/probabilities.qmd">Practise</a></div>
:::
::: {.advent-card #day-15}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">15</span><span class="advent-time">7 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">UNCERTAINTY</p>
<h4>What does entropy measure?</h4>
<p>Compute the entropy of a small distribution and distinguish it from calibration.</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="entropy.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="exercises/entropy.qmd">Practise</a></div>
:::
::: {.advent-card #day-16}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">16</span><span class="advent-time">7 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">DECODING</p>
<h4>Selecting the next token</h4>
<p>Compare greedy decoding, temperature, and sampling.</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="generation.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="decoding-strategies.qmd">Deepen</a></div>
:::
::: {.advent-card #day-17}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">17</span><span class="advent-time">7 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">AUTOREGRESSIVE LOOP</p>
<h4>A prediction becomes the next context</h4>
<p>Trace token-by-token generation with fixed parameters.</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="generation.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="exercises/generation.qmd">Practise</a></div>
:::
::: {.advent-card #day-18}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">18</span><span class="advent-time">8 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">EFFICIENT INFERENCE</p>
<h4>Prefill, decode, and the KV cache</h4>
<p>Distinguish initial context processing from incremental decoding.</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="generation.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="exercises/generation.qmd">Practise</a></div>
:::
:::

::: {.advent-act-heading}
<span class="advent-act-number">19 — 24</span>
<div><h3>Scoring and learning</h3><p>What changes when the target is observed, and how do model parameters learn?</p></div>
</div>
:::

::: {.advent-grid}
::: {.advent-card #day-19}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">19</span><span class="advent-time">8 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">OBSERVED TARGET</p>
<h4>Predicting with a known target</h4>
<p>Distinguish the observed prefix, target token, and teacher forcing.</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="likelihood.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="training-examples.qmd">See training examples</a><a href="exercises/training-examples.qmd">Practise</a></div>
:::
::: {.advent-card #day-20}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">20</span><span class="advent-time">8 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">LIKELIHOOD</p>
<h4>What probability does a sequence receive?</h4>
<p>Connect conditional probabilities, sequence likelihood, and log-likelihood.</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="likelihood.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="exercises/likelihood.qmd">Practise</a></div>
:::
::: {.advent-card #day-21}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">21</span><span class="advent-time">8 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">PROBABILISTIC COST</p>
<h4>From probability to cost</h4>
<p>Connect negative log-likelihood, per-token NLL, and cross-entropy for a one-hot target.</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="cross-entropy.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="exercises/cross-entropy.qmd">Practise</a></div>
:::
::: {.advent-card #day-22}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">22</span><span class="advent-time">8 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">TRAINING OBJECTIVE</p>
<h4>From token costs to a loss</h4>
<p>Understand masking, reduction, and aggregation over valid tokens.</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="loss.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="exercises/loss.qmd">Practise</a></div>
:::
::: {.advent-card #day-23}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">23</span><span class="advent-time">8 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">DIFFERENTIATION</p>
<h4>How do we obtain gradients?</h4>
<p>Interpret derivatives of the loss with respect to the model parameters.</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="gradients.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="exercises/gradients.qmd">Practise</a></div>
:::
::: {.advent-card #day-24}
<div class="advent-card-top"><span class="advent-number">24</span><span class="advent-time">8 min</span></div>
<p class="advent-card-kicker">UPDATES & EVALUATION</p>
<h4>Update parameters or evaluate the model?</h4>
<p>Distinguish optimizer updates from evaluation with fixed parameters.</p>
<div class="advent-card-links"><a href="training-loop.qmd">Read the lesson <span>→</span></a><a href="experimental-evaluation.qmd">Evaluate a model</a></div>
:::
:::
